fact: Libreville's municipal street naming and door numbering, halted at the end of 2021, has resumed, with 5,000 of 60,000 door numbers placed, funded by AIMF and the EU.

Le360 Afrique reports Libreville's addressing project, launched in 2012 with AIMF funding to name 3,650 streets, has partly produced named streets but appears to be running out of steam, and the city still lacks a reliable toponymy.
